limitations: Source-only target/support preparation, not learned decoding, inference or scientific qualification.
Three TRAIN graph groups per observed class remains the diagnostic threshold; actual current-version class minimum is15.
Source-derived actual variable/version maps are targets and validation metadata, never features.
Controls tie identical canonical visible prefixes, lexical and pre-query query relatives, but need not form lawful joint SSA graphs and do not preserve class marginals.
Slot-complete version coverage is not full class or joint-graph balance; rotations/numeric/lexical/query relatives remain dependent.
All selected canonical graph families, source IDs, cyclic rotations, splits and numeric values were validated against the SHA-pinned published generation recipe.
